title: Three modes, three different interpretations
caption: Mode taxonomy. Glyphs encode a vector, geometric mode projects a coordinate-wise walk, and trajectory mode projects ordered model states. The modes should not be interpreted interchangeably.
provenance: Explanatory schematic derived from the report; not a screenshot or new experiment.

title: A coordinate walk ends at the original vector
caption: Coordinate-walk construction, shown symbolically rather than as measured model data. Permuting coordinates changes the chosen path even though its endpoint remains the input vector.
provenance: Explanatory schematic derived from the report; not a screenshot or new experiment.

title: Compare trajectories in one shared basis
caption: Shared-PCA workflow for the reported BERT jaguar demonstration. Independent PCA fits would create unrelated coordinate systems and undermine direct visual comparison.

title: Layer order supplies the trajectory
caption: Trajectory-mode schematic. Each vertex is a token representation from an actual stage of the model; the arrows indicate successive state differences, not semantic labels for dimensions.
